user.title: Companion App APK Mirror
user.description: Mirrors the Home Assistant companion app APK from GitHub and serves it on this Home Assistant's own URL, so a local tablet can update without the Play Store.

data_description.flavor: 'full' includes Google services (push notifications), 'minimal' does not. Pick the one that matches your tablet.
data_description.require_auth: Leave off so the tablet can download the APK without logging in. The endpoints only serve the public APK.
data_description.github_token: Only needed if you hit GitHub's anonymous API rate limit of 60 requests per hour.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the GitHub API.
error.invalid_auth: GitHub rejected the token, or the anonymous rate limit was reached.
error.no_release: No recent release publishes an APK for this build flavor.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Companion App APK Mirror is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the GitHub API.
error.invalid_auth: GitHub rejected the token, or the anonymous rate limit was reached.
error.no_release: No recent release publishes an APK for this build flavor.

download.name: Download APK
download.description: Mirrors a release APK into Home Assistant and serves it locally.

version.name: Version
version.description: Release to mirror, for example 2026.11.1. Defaults to the newest release.

refresh.name: Check for a new release
refresh.description: Queries GitHub immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled check.

purge.name: Purge old APKs
purge.description: Deletes mirrored APKs beyond the newest few.

keep_versions.name: Versions to keep
keep_versions.description: How many of the newest APKs to keep. Defaults to the configured value.
